data.gender_notes: Neer is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Neer means 'water' or 'river'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the purifying and nurturing power of water. The name Neer carries the meaning “Water, River” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Neer usually hope their child will grow to embody water, river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the life-giving and purifying power of water.
data.etymology: Neer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Water, River.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neer total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

Neer is chanted, offered, or used in various rituals and ceremonies signifying spiritual growth and renewal. data.spiritual_significance: In the Hindu spiritual tradition, water represents the divine mother, 'Ganga Mata', who purifies the mind and soul. Neer embodies these cleansing and purifying attributes, providing an uplifting spiritual connection. The name inspires not only refreshing and calming emotions but invites one on an introspective journey towards profound inner growth, peace, and enlightenment.
